title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：已迁址

excerpt.zh: 在与其前中心失去联络之后，星系商贸团体选择在我们境内设立一座新的空间站。
excerpt.en: Following loss of contact with their former hub, the galactic merchant community has chosen to establish a new station within our borders.
